description: Dispatch reach-paths: the enforced-root-aware help open (open_root_help) with cmd:<ROOT> precedence over the KEYS/CONFIG feature: special-cases (context-help Req 22.1/22.8), repoint of the HELP <arg> ladder arm, and the --help/-h//? prelude short-circuit on the single front door (command-semantics Req 15). No new dispatcher; reuses the existing open_help seam. Depends on FEAT-001 only indirectly (open_root_help resolves cmd:<ROOT>; it needs no extractor). Keep it after FEAT-001 for a clean integration order.
steps: TDD: write FAILING ff-desktop tests FIRST (a new module e.g. crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/tests_help_flag.rs, or extend tests_nav.rs following the `shell.handle_command("HELP")` pattern): `HELP KEYS` resolves cmd:KEYS NOT feature:function_keys; `HELP CONFIG` resolves cmd:CONFIG NOT feature:configuration; `HELP LINECOMMANDS` still resolves line:index; `HELP OFF` still closes; a non-root `HELP CHANGE` still opens cmd:CHANGE. Assert via the help context panel's shown topic key or the registry miss path, mirroring existing HELP tests. Annotate `// Validates: context-help Requirement 22.1`/`22.8`.

Implement `pub(super) fn open_root_help(&mut self, verb: &str)` in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/help.rs: trim+uppercase verb; if it is a member (case-insensitive) of crate::shell::alias_reader::builtin_ffcmd_roots(), build ff_help::TopicKey::command(<UPPER>) and call self.display_help_topic(&key) directly (bypassing resolve_help_argument so KEYS->cmd:KEYS, CONFIG->cmd:CONFIG); else delegate to self.open_help(verb). Confirm OFF/INDEX/LINECOMMANDS/MACRO/API are NOT in builtin_ffcmd_roots() so they keep flowing through open_help/resolve_help_argument.

Repoint the HELP arm in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/commands_ladder_a.rs (~line 189): keep bare `if upper == "HELP" { self.open_help(""); return true; }`; change the `if let Some(arg) = verb_arg(cmd, "HELP")` arm to call `self.open_root_help(arg)` instead of `self.open_help(arg)`.

TDD: write FAILING ff-desktop tests FIRST for the --help short-circuit: `EXIT --help` opens cmd:EXIT and does NOT set the app-close flag (assert no execution side effect); `-h` and `/?` behave identically; `SS --help` opens cmd:SNAPSHOT (alias rewrite runs first); `FIND --help foo` (help flag is the FIRST arg token) short-circuits but `FIND foo --help` does NOT; a missing topic degrades to the 'No help available' affordance (no unrecognised-command error, no panic); `FILE CATALOGS --help` and `RESET BARE --help` do NOT short-circuit (two-word deferred, Req 15.9) while `HELP FILE CATALOGS` / `HELP RESET BARE` resolve their cmd: topics. Annotate `// Validates: command-semantics Requirement 15.x`.

Add `pub(super) fn first_token_is_help_flag(arg: &str) -> bool` in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/helpers.rs next to split_verb_arg: take the first whitespace-delimited token of arg; return true if it equals `--help` or `-h` (case-insensitive) or `/?` (exact).

Wire the short-circuit into crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/dispatch.rs::dispatch_command_string: AFTER `let raw = self.rewrite_verb_to_root(raw); let raw = raw.as_str();` and BEFORE `if self.run_command_prelude(raw, &upper) { return; }`, split raw via split_verb_arg; if first_token_is_help_flag(arg) then call self.open_root_help(verb) and return (short-circuit: command does not execute; like HELP, not recorded in history/undo). Single-token verbs only; the two-word roots naturally do not fire (their first arg token is not a help flag).
Keep each touched file <= 400 non-test lines (move new tests into a dedicated tests_* module). ASCII-only.
acceptance_criteria: open_root_help resolves cmd:<ROOT> directly for a builtin_ffcmd_roots() member (KEYS->cmd:KEYS, CONFIG->cmd:CONFIG) and falls back to open_help otherwise; the feature:function_keys / feature:configuration topics remain reachable via the Index/menus (context-help Req 22.1/22.8).

`HELP <ROOT>` (ladder) and `<ROOT> --help`/`-h`/`/?` (front-door prelude) both reach the SAME cmd:<ROOT> topic through the one open_help/display seam; no new dispatcher is added (framework-conformance mechanism 1).

The --help short-circuit runs AFTER rewrite_verb_to_root and BEFORE run_command_prelude/resolve_target, so `EXIT --help` opens help WITHOUT executing EXIT; `SS --help` opens cmd:SNAPSHOT; a missing topic degrades gracefully (command-semantics Req 15.1-15.8).
Two-word roots FILE CATALOGS / RESET BARE do NOT short-circuit on --help (deferred, Req 15.9) but remain reachable via HELP <ROOT>.
`cargo test -p ff-desktop` focused tests for the new behaviour pass; clippy clean with -D warnings.
verification: C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cargo test -p ff-desktop open_root_help"  (read proxy result; expect the new HELP-precedence tests pass)
C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cargo test -p ff-desktop help_flag"  (expect the --help short-circuit tests pass)

Files: crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/{help.rs (open_root_help), commands_ladder_a.rs (HELP arm repoint), helpers.rs (first_token_is_help_flag), dispatch.rs (--help short-circuit), mod.rs (register test module), tests_help_flag.rs (NEW, 11 tests)}. Scoped verify all clean: check (Finished), clippy --all-targets -D warnings (0), fmt --check (0), cargo test --bin ffwb tests_help_flag 11 passed/0 failed. KEY LEARNING: handle_command() does NOT route through the front door dispatch_command_string; the --help short-circuit lives on the front door, so the short-circuit tests call dispatch_command_string (HELP-ladder tests use handle_command, which hits the repointed ladder arm). SS->SNAPSHOT is a USER alias, not a default seed, so the SS --help test overlays it via alias_store.overlay_row_for_test(active_environment_name(), ...). KNOWN FOLLOW-UP: shell/help.rs is ~499 non-test lines (pre-existing; 462 before this change), over the 400-line rust-standards limit -- a behaviour-preserving split is separate refactor work outside FEAT-002 scope (the plan directs adding open_root_help to the existing impl block).
